title: Serpent & Dove
author: Shelby Mahurin
summary: A young witch on the run and a witch-hunting soldier are forced into marriage in a city where magic is punished by death. She keeps her true nature hidden while their uneasy bond grows.
readIf: you like enemies-to-lovers stories with high stakes, fairy-tale touches and witty banter.
skipIf: you want romance without religious persecution or violence, because both are central.

pairings.reason: Another young-adult fantasy where a heroine must survive among powerful people who loathe her kind.
A fantasy romance that also begins with a forced union, a hunt and a fairy-tale base.
Another young-adult fantasy with a hidden heroine and a dark love interest.
